clue.text: Plant to hang gracefully in secluded place

indicators.note: the hanging-gracefully word sits within the secluded-place word

parts.note: a corner is a quiet, tucked-away spot
hair or fabric that flows hangs in a loose, graceful way

explanation.surface: Gardening advice: a plant that will droop prettily in some quiet nook.
explanation.definitionFit: The blue-flowered weed of cereal fields is a familiar garden annual.

clue.text: Officer leading a thousand soldiers ultimately deserved praise

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
men are ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: ultimately points to the closing letter of the word deserved

explanation.surface: A commander and his thousand troops have finally earned some acclaim.
explanation.definitionFit: To commend someone is to speak of them approvingly, a verb meaning to applaud.

clue.text: Lucre comes with art I broadcast in the network

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase, matching the answer, which describes something net-like

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: Money and art mingle as they are transmitted across a broadcasting network.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticular describes a structure shaped like a mesh or net, from Latin reticulum, little net.

clue.text: Satisfying requirements, as pelican's feast may be?

definitions.meaning: an idiom meaning being exactly what is needed
a pelican stores fish in the pouch of its beak, so its meal is literally stuffing that beak

explanation.surface: Doing just what is needed, like a pelican stuffing its beak with fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means doing what is required, and literally describes stuffing a beak.

clue.text: One girl in 20 to play histrionically

indicators.note: the girl is placed within the abbreviation of the month named at 20

parts.note: the answer to 20 Down is a month, abbreviated OCT
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: One girl out of twenty is chosen to perform in a melodramatic way.
explanation.walkthrough: '20' is not a number but a cross-reference to 20 Down, whose answer abbreviates to OCT.
explanation.definitionFit: To ham it up on stage is to exaggerate a performance theatrically.

clue.text: Stylish short poem to introduce a collection of books

indicators.note: short means the poem word loses its final letter

parts.note: an elegy is a mournful poem
NT is the New Testament, a collection of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A brief, stylish poem serves as an introduction to an anthology.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to introduce' is positional only: the short poem and A come before NT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elegant has grace and refinement, a synonym for chic or fashionable.

clue.text: Blow the whistle on business

definitions.meaning: British slang for informing on them to the police

explanation.surface: An employee considers reporting their firm's wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang to inform on someone is to grass, and a retail outlet is a business.

clue.text: One hemmed in by lots of people in lift

indicators.note: the single letter is surrounded by the crowd word

parts.note: a host is a large number, a multitude
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: One passenger is squeezed in among a crowd in an elevator.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoist is to raise something up, a verb meaning to haul upwards.

clue.text: Writer wanting a new church sacrament for sinners

parts.note: a pen is something that writes
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An author seeks fresh religious rite for wrongdoers.
explanation.definitionFit: Confession and absolution, the sacrament of reconciliation, is traditionally called this in the Catholic church.

clue.text: Horrible place is real pit — there's limited sunlight in it

indicators.note: horrible suggests the letters are mangled into an awful new arrangement

explanation.surface: A grim hole of a place, so dark that hardly any sunshine gets in.
explanation.definitionFit: When the moon covers only part of the sun, daylight is reduced rather than lost entirely.

clue.text: Former money initially circulated — gold or silver?

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word money
circulated means moved around, so the letters are shuffled

parts.note: late means former, as in the late president

explanation.surface: Old coinage once passed around — were the coins gold or silver?
explanation.definitionFit: Gold and silver are both examples of precious elements of this kind.

clue.text: No plan for promotion

definitions.meaning: in architecture this is a side view drawing, as opposed to a plan, which is drawn from above

explanation.surface: Someone is moved up the ladder without any strategy.
explanation.definitionFit: An architect's side-view drawing contrasts with a plan; advancement to higher rank is also meant.

clue.text: Can a deli change to include hot, spicy food?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in the extra letter
change means alter, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: Could a delicatessen alter its menu to offer something hot and fiery?
explanation.definitionFit: A Mexican dish of rolled tortillas filled and covered in chilli sauce.

clue.text: Painter Italy initially ignored, a person of huge significance

indicators.note: ignored means left out, so a letter is dropped from the painter

parts.note: Titian was a Venetian Renaissance painter

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word Italy

explanation.surface: A painter whom Italy at first overlooked turned out to be a giant of his age.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant figure of great importance, from the race of mythical Greek giants.

clue.text: Journalist bowled over by trivial pleasure

indicators.note: bowled over means knocked upside down, so the journalist is read backwards

parts.note: ED is short for editor
light can mean slight or unimportant, as in light reading

explanation.surface: A reporter is knocked out by some small joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Joy or great enjoyment, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: A priest disguised as tramp

indicators.note: disguised means the letters are dressed up in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A clergyman goes about in disguise as a vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: Tramp as a verb means to trudge wearily, as does this word.

clue.text: Soldier dominating high ground? That's of the greatest importance

indicators.note: in a down clue the soldier sits above the high ground

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
a mount is a hill or mountain

explanation.surface: A soldier holding the heights is the top priority.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme or chief, ranking above everything else.

clue.text: High-ranking officer as personification of war, bluff character

parts.note: Mars is the Roman god of war
Henry VIII was known as bluff King Hal

explanation.surface: A senior commander is likened to the war god and a hearty fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: Henry VIII of England was nicknamed 'bluff King Hal', bluff meaning hearty and blunt.
explanation.definitionFit: A field marshal is the highest army rank in Britain.

clue.text: A joke disrupts my dignity

indicators.note: disrupts means breaks into, so the joke goes inside my

parts.note: a jest is a joke

explanation.surface: Someone's composure is broken by a gag.
explanation.definitionFit: Majesty is stately grandeur or impressive dignity.

clue.text: Boat with less ballast?

definitions.meaning: a flat-bottomed barge used to ferry goods to and from ships

explanation.surface: A vessel carrying reduced weight in the hold.
explanation.definitionFit: A barge used for unloading ships, and also weighing less.

clue.text: For so long there's happiness — then one has nothing

parts.note: cheer is gladness
I is the Roman numeral one
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: A farewell toast: good spirits, then one finishes with nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: So long is an informal goodbye, and this is a British way of saying goodbye.

clue.text: Pound I found among small foreign change provided by these customers

indicators.note: among puts the pound sign and I inside the small coins

parts.note: cents are small coins in many foreign currencies
L stands for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper finds a pound amid a pile of foreign coins left by shoppers.
explanation.definitionFit: Patrons of a business who buy its services, a synonym.

clue.text: Corn cut and processed, to be stored in autumn period

indicators.note: the two small words are kept inside the processed letters
processed means treated, so the letters are rearranged
cut means the word corn loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Harvested grain is processed and put in storage in the autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: The tenth month falls in autumn in the northern hemisphere.

clue.text: Person who cheated brother, one liable to get fleeced

definitions.meaning: in Genesis he tricked Esau out of his birthright and blessing
a rare piebald breed of sheep has this name, and sheep are shorn of their fleece

explanation.surface: A man who swindled his brother may now be the one getting robbed.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical son of Isaac, and also a breed of spotted sheep.

clue.text: Place for boats made of tin and aluminium

parts.note: a can is a tin container
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: A boat built from tin and aluminium.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial waterway is where narrowboats travel.

clue.text: Bird feeling bad, having eaten sour fruit mostly

indicators.note: having eaten means the feeling-bad word swallows the fruit

parts.note: guilt is the bad feeling of having done wrong

indicators.note: mostly means the fruit word loses its last letter

parts.note: a lemon is a sour citrus fruit

explanation.surface: A bird feels sick after gobbling up most of a lemon.
explanation.definitionFit: A seabird of the auk family nesting on cliff ledges.

clue.text: Garment being worn in just one club, say

parts.note: a singlet is a vest
clothing that is on is being worn

explanation.surface: Wearing only a vest to a golf club.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, holding just one card of a suit, such as one club, is so called.
explanation.definitionFit: A lone card in a suit in a bridge hand, as a club might be.

clue.text: Bob's dead right

definitions.meaning: a lead weight on a line used for checking verticals
exactly, as in ... in the middle

explanation.surface: Someone named Bob has died, which is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumb bob is a weight on a line, and the word also means exactly.

clue.text: Being old, you will clamour for attention, maybe

definitions.meaning: an old form of you plus the contraction of will

explanation.surface: When you are elderly you will make a fuss to be noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shout loudly is one way to clamour; ye'll is archaic for you will.

clue.text: My stuff got panned, almost all of it being dross

definitions.text: My stuff got panned, almost all of it being dross

parts.words: My stuff got panned, almost all of it being dross
parts.note: read as a critic's verdict on worthless work, but panning is washing gravel for gold, where most is waste

explanation.surface: An artist laments that critics slated nearly all their worthless output.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone washing river gravel in a pan searching for gold is a seeker of minerals.
